title: Chapter 840
text:
[Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device]!

Han Xiaoxin was shocked. He was not unfamiliar with this item. This was a Universal Treasure that the Radiant Federation had invested countless resources into, and it was their special technology. Just like how the Evolutionary Civilization had created the Evolution Cube, civilizations that had reached the level of Universal Treasures had basically created Universal Treasures.

The principle behind this item was related to high-dimensional projection and materialization. An army would be teleported to the target location and then restored to its original dimension, achieving the effect of crossing dimensions.

To be specific, it was like turning the universe into a flat two-dimensional picture, and the teleported army became a three-dimensional object. Because the obstacles in the two-dimensional picture would not affect the three-dimensional image, the teleported object could move freely on the surface of the two-dimensional picture.

Normal artificial wormhole countermeasures would not be able to counter the [Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device]. This technology had been the trump card of the Radiant Federation since the exploration era, allowing their fleet to have extremely high mobility. It was extremely terrifying from a war perspective.

Relying on this technology, the Radiant Federation had defeated countless strong enemies in the exploration era and survived all the way to the new era.

There were also disadvantages. First, the resources consumed for each use were extremely shocking, increasing with the distance and the number of units teleported. Second, the charging time was very long. Third, ultra-long-distance teleportation required precise positioning and a long period of guidance. Fourth, the [Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device] was a large equipment similar to a stargate and would not be teleported out together. Thus, the troops that were sent out could not be retrieved through the same method unless they brought another [Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device].

Of course, the Radiant Federation would not hand over their special Universal Treasure to the Arcane Church. The condition of cooperation was to teleport them over, but they were not obligated to help them retreat.

"Sh * t, the Radiant Federation actually intervened …"

Looking at the image of the Arcane Church's fleet descending, everyone in the command room was shocked, and their hearts sank to the bottom.

Han Xiao also did not expect the enemy to work together with the Radiant Federation and be immune to the wormhole countermeasures, using special means to directly descend on Planet Lighthouse.

The cooperation between the Arcane Church and the Radiant Federation was beyond his expectation. Both of them had done such a good job of keeping secrets that the Empire's intelligence channels did not receive any information beforehand.

Tarrokov had predicted that the enemy would launch a sneak attack from the outside, so he had sent out quite a number of battleships. As a result, Planet Lighthouse's defense was rather weak, and there were only about a million battleships left. On the other hand, the millions of enemy battleships were floating in the outer space of Planet Lighthouse, bringing about immense pressure.

The situation took a turn for the worse, and Planet Lighthouse was forced into a dangerous situation.

The combat room became completely silent. Everyone's expressions were grim and shocked, and a great sense of danger rose in their hearts.

Tarrokov broke the silence and maintained his composure. "Apart from stopping EsGod's troops, the other fleets are to return immediately. There's no need to be on guard anymore. Also, inform the guards at the stargate stations to blow up all the stargates. We cannot let them fall into the enemy's hands."

"Blow up Planet Lighthouse's stargate station? You're crazy! That's our only way out! "Beyoni was shocked and furious.

Tarrokov was expressionless. "The stargate station is too close to Planet Lighthouse, and the Arcane Church will definitely send out troops to snatch it. Our strength is at a disadvantage, and if we forcefully defend, we will only continue to scatter the troops at Planet Lighthouse. EsGod and the Arcane Church's fleet is almost twice the size of ours. We won't be able to fight on two fronts, and we definitely won't be able to defend. We can't split up any more troops at this juncture. "

"But without the stargates, our only way out …"

"We're already in a desperate situation, and there's no way out." Tarrokov was resolute. "Our only hope is to gather all our troops and make use of the defense of Planet Lighthouse to hold on until reinforcements arrive. Without the stargate stations, we still have a lot of stargate equipment in our warehouse. When the reinforcements arrive at the other stargate, we can immediately set up a stargate channel. Now that the reinforcements have yet to arrive, splitting up our troops to defend the stargate stations will only cause us to lose even faster."

Tarrokov purposely made it sound like he had a plan, but everyone knew that it was not as easy as he made it sound. Setting up the stargate equipment required quite a bit of time, and would the enemy just sit there and do nothing? Obviously not!

When the reinforcements arrived at the channel, they would have to open the stargate in front of the enemy, and a bloody battle would definitely break out. The problem was, they might not even be able to hold on until the reinforcements arrived.

At this moment, the image suddenly locked onto six figures in front of the Arcane Church fleet.

After seeing their appearances, Tarrokov's face could not help but reveal a look of shock.

'Photon' Sagman, 'Desolate Beast' Mercer, 'Divine Technique' Ninjia, 'World Gate' Taylor, 'Star Pupil' Sisko, 'Sea Spirit' Dylan …

Six Beyond Grade A Supers?

That was twice as many as they had on their side!

With the addition of EsGod …

Tarrokov, Milizaus, and Beyoni's hearts sank. The Arcane Church was too determined to kill, and they were not even afraid of the consequences of starting a war with the dynasty.

Milizaus and Beyoni started to regret. The two of them had volunteered to be Black Star's bodyguards for the Evolution Cube, but they did not expect that they would have to pay with their lives this time.

They really should not have gotten involved in this mess …

The two of them could not help but turn to look at Han Xiao, only to realize that Han Xiao had closed his eyes unknowingly.

"What are you doing …"

Before they could finish asking, intense Mechanical Force suddenly erupted from Han Xiao's body. Under the senses of the two of them, the energy level in Han Xiao's body started to fluctuate violently, and it was rapidly increasing.

When he saw the soldiers of the Arcane Church descend from the sky, Han Xiao could not care about the others in the room anymore. He immediately opened the interface and poured all his experience into leveling up!

At such a critical moment, he could no longer care about saving his experience during the penalty period! Every bit of strength counted!

It had been seven to eight months since he became a Beyond Grade A Super. During this time, Han Xiao had harvested the players from the other Star Fields and guided the Flickering World Main Storyline Mission. Coupled with the bonus from his Political Assets, he had accumulated a large amount of experience.

Even if the cost of leveling up at this level was astronomical, even with the additional forty percent experience loss during the penalty period, the experience he had accumulated was enough for him to rush from level 240 to level 260!

Boiling energy surged out of his cells and surged through his body!

A series of notifications popped up.

…

[Emperor Mechanic] leveled up to Lv.35 (max). + 1,000 Energy, + 5 STR, + 5 DEX, + 8 END, + 12 INT. You have received 10 Free Attribute Points. You have received 1 Potential Point.

You have reached the upper limit of your Main Class. You have triggered the Class Advancement Mission: (All Rivers in the Sea).

(All Rivers in the Sea): Visit one hundred Mechanic Supers of Grade A and above and exchange your mechanical skills with them. A powerful Mechanic will never build a car behind closed doors and will know how to summarize their own skills through exchanges.

You have reached level 260. You have triggered the Promotion Mission: (The Never-Ending Challenger).

After reaching the level 260 bottleneck, the Class Advancement Mission and Promotion Mission appeared at the same time.

None of the Random Rewards he had accumulated during this period had given him a Mission Completion Card. Instead, he had obtained two blank Character Summon Cards and one Skill Upgrade Card. However, he only had one Mission Completion Card, which was left over from before, so he could only skip one of the missions.

Seeing these two missions, Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed. There was always a way!

(All Rivers in the Sea) was a very time-consuming Class Advancement Mission. In the entire universe, there were definitely one hundred Calamity Grade Mechanics, but they were all in different regions. This mission was obviously the most time-consuming, and he had to earn the favorability of one hundred targets so that they would be willing to communicate with him.

Although it was cumbersome, the only benefit for the players was that it was not difficult at all.

In comparison, this Promotion Mission was much more difficult for the ordinary players. Challenging a Beyond Grade A Super head-on and lasting thirty seconds was a requirement that would only appear in the later stages of the Promotion Mission. Thirty seconds was not impossible, but the difficult part was the requirement of 'surviving'.

There were two common ways for the players to complete this mission. The first was to be indifferent to life and death and leave it up to fate.

The second method was much more reliable, which was to join a faction with a Beyond Grade A Super and earn the favorability of the Beyond Grade A Super in exchange for a chance to spar. Since it was a spar, even if the Beyond Grade A Super lost, they would not kill. Although it would take a lot of time, the second method had a higher success rate. After all, the interface would not cause all the players to be stuck on the Promotion Mission.

However, to Han Xiao, this mission was not difficult at all. Not to mention one Beyond Grade A, he already had six Beyond Grade A Supers on his head. Including EsGod, he had the same number of eyes as Sisko!

Without hesitation, Han Xiao directly used the Mission Completion Card on (All Rivers in the Sea).

In comparison, only the Promotion Mission could be completed in an extremely short amount of time.

However, the only problem was that the Promotion Mission could only be completed after he left the battle. If he was entangled by the enemy, it would not be so easy to leave the battle.

Han Xiao suddenly turned around and said, "Beyoni, fight with me immediately!"

“？？？”

Everyone's face was filled with question marks.

Is there something wrong with your brain in front of the enemy?

Are you going to join the Arcane Church and become a traitor in order to survive?

Rumble!

Right at this moment, the room suddenly shook, and a series of explosions sounded from the sky.

The Arcane Church in outer space launched their attack. While fighting with the defense fleet, they shot out psionic bombs to bombard the surface of Planet Lighthouse. Explosions continuously exploded on the protective shield of the planet-level base, causing the ground to tremble.

Indeed, the enemy even sent a fleet toward the stargate station not far away with the intention of snatching it, proving Tarrokov's foresight.

With millions of enemy battleships attacking, the dynasty fleet, the Black Star Corps fleet, the Dragon Blood Country fleet, and the Flame Demon fleet all launched their own counterattacks.

Cannon fire was exchanged, and the sky of Planet Lighthouse was dyed into a colorful canvas. The colors of countless energy beams were like the aurora, beautiful and deadly.

On the other side, the enemy's strongest Beyond Grade A, 'Photon' Sagman, brought 'Divine Spell' Ninjia and engaged in a fierce battle with Milizaus' main body in outer space.

Milizaus knew teleportation spells and tried many times. However, 'Divine Spell' Ninjia was also a Beyond Grade A Mage and interrupted his teleportation spells time and time again.

The other four Beyond Grade As, including Sisko, charged into the defense line of the dynasty fleet and headed straight for the surface. Their goal was obviously to flatten the base on Planet Lighthouse and force Han Xiao and Beyoni out!

"All surface troops, attack and defend against the enemy's attack!" Tarrokov ordered decisively. "Black Star, Beyoni, we can only rely on you guys to deal with those four Beyond Grade As. We have no other choice."

Although he knew that Black Star was the enemy's target, such a situation did not allow a Beyond Grade A to avoid battle. Only by resisting would they have a chance of survival.

"I understand." Han Xiao's expression was solemn.

At this critical moment, there was no time to waste on sparring with Beyoni. He could only complete the Promotion mission on the enemy.

Xiu!

The next moment, two figures flew out of the base together like two streams of light, one black and one red, heading straight for the four Beyond Grade As of the Arcane Church.

On the way, Han Xiao opened the secondary dimensional army box and released all his mechanical troops. The black tide carried his body all the way into the sky.

Very soon, the two sides met in the sky, and it was two against four.

A strong gust of wind blew on the bodies of the six of them. The six of them seemed to have been nailed to the sky, and their figures did not move at all.

The terrifying energy fluctuations of the four of them were like an ocean, and Beyoni's heart was filled with pressure.

He knew that he did not have a physique as outstanding as Han Xiao's, and his chances of dying were probably higher than Black Star's.

The two sides stared at each other in silence for a few seconds before Sisko spoke coldly.

His tone was filled with firm killing intent.

"I reminded you before … when you took the Evolution Cube, did you think that this day would come?"

Han Xiao ignored him. He did not have the time to chat with him before the battle. He calmed down and observed the four strong enemies. They were Pugilists, Mages, Psychics, and Espers.

Four Beyond Grade As. Even with my recovery speed, I won't be able to hold them off. Looks like I'll have to use up all of Aurora's Character Summon Cards and potions this time. I hope that guy can come quickly to share the pressure …

Han Xiao clenched his teeth and threw all the Free Attribute Points he obtained from leveling up into Endurance. With the high Endurance conversion rate, his health increased by another 200,000 or so.

The difference in strength was too great. He could only try to increase his tankiness as much as possible!

The next moment, the six of them moved at the same time.

The battle suddenly erupted!

…

On the other side, EsGod was still leading his fleet to break through the security sector.

EsGod asked Haakisen to ask when the Arcane Church would attack, but the reply he received shocked him.

"The Arcane Church received the help of the Radiant Federation and directly teleported into the hinterland of Planet Lighthouse? They even sent out six Beyond Grade As? "

EsGod's expression changed slightly. He thought about it and decisively gave the order.

"Everyone, listen up. Increase your speed immediately!"

The Arcane Church actually sent out six Beyond Grade As. EsGod did not know how long Planet Lighthouse could last under such a terrifying attack.

If the Arcane Church had already taken back the Evolution Cube before he arrived, he did not think that the Arcane Church would fulfill their agreement and let him borrow the Evolution Cube. Furthermore, he would not be able to snatch it from the hands of six Beyond Grade As.

Thus, EsGod was a little anxious and planned to quickly join the battle to get a share of the loot.
